_about: Order of the road. Chapter content lives in content/walkthrough/{region}.json; this file only fixes the order and the crossings between regions. Reconciled against the completed natural playthrough (blonde/qa/natural-run-v100..v102).

regions.name: Johto
regions.tagline: Heritage, lantern light and the long road to the League.
regions.blurb: Your journey starts in New Bark Town and winds through shrine towns, old forests and eight Gyms on the way to the Indigo Plateau.

regions.name: Kanto
regions.tagline: An open region, one recommended journey.
regions.blurb: Sail to Vermilion, follow the Power Plant story and finish the eastern Gyms before opening the west. This recommended route follows Project Blonde’s Gym levels; the League rematch is optional.

regions.name: Hoenn
regions.blurb: A third region opens after Kanto: the full Hoenn story, eight Gyms and a new League, tuned for a team that has already won two. Opponents start at Level 80.

regions.name: Postgame
regions.blurb: Rematches, the ferry, side stories and everything that has no fixed order. The Alola isles and Lillie’s story are open from Kanto onwards.

kanto.title: S.S. Aqua
kanto.text: With the Johto League behind you, Professor Elm hands you a ticket and a ship sails from Olivine’s harbour to Kanto.

hoenn.title: The road to Hoenn
hoenn.text: Red, then Ash, then a call from Professor Oak: Professor Birch’s truck is waiting in Pallet Town.

postgame.title: After the credits
postgame.text: Three regions cleared. What follows has no fixed order.
